profile.historySummary: The university grew out of the Calabar campus of the University of Nigeria, Nsukka, which began operating in the 1973/1974 academic session. The Federal Military Government announced in April 1975 that the Calabar campus would become a full university. UNICAL states that its academic journey as a full university began in October 1976.

steps: Open the official UNICAL student portal.
New undergraduate candidates: buy the status PIN through the portal, then check admission with the JAMB registration number and PIN.
After an offer is confirmed, follow the portal's account-creation and acceptance instructions.
Returning students: activate using the matriculation number or JAMB number and surname, then set the email address and password.
Already activated students: sign in with the matriculation/JAMB number and password.
For activation or payment problems, use the portal Help page and the official university contact channels.
Open the official Post-UTME/Direct Entry portal.
Select the correct admission route and follow the session-specific notice.
Use only the official portal for application and payment instructions.
For any payment or document issue, contact the university through its published official contact channel.

The website states 20 undergraduate programmes across three faculties, but the complete current list and department mapping have not yet been extracted.
The current Vice-Chancellor's profile and current admission workflow should be checked before publishing.

profile.historySummary: AUST states that it was founded in 2007 as one of the Nelson Mandela Institutes, with a mandate focused on science, technology, energy and materials. The NUC lists it as a private university established in 2007.

knownGaps: The ten programmes listed are newly approved for 2026/2027 and do not constitute the complete AUST programme catalogue.
Current VC/Chancellor identities were not verified from a current AUST institutional leadership page in this pass.
Programme-specific JAMB subject combinations and cut-offs remain to be checked against the exact course and current JAMB IBASS data.

profile.historySummary: Ahmadu Bello University was established on 4 October 1962 as the University of Northern Nigeria. Its official history identifies three main campuses: Samaru and Kongo in Zaria, and the School of Basic Studies in Funtua.

knownGaps: The official undergraduate catalogue initially displayed 114 undergraduate records, but the 20-record first page is only a partial extraction.
A current 2026/2027 admission notice and official application portal were not captured in this pass.
Course-specific subject combinations and current session cut-offs remain to be matched against JAMB IBASS and the university's current admission notice.
The NUC lists the university as a private institution established in 2021 and lists Professor Adebola Mahfouz Adedimeji as Vice-Chancellor.
A third-party hosted school portal was found, but no canonical institution-owned website or official applicant portal was verified. It is not imported or recommended.
Official programme list, faculty/department hierarchy, current admissions requirements and current leadership page need direct institutional confirmation.

profile.historySummary: The NUC's current NUS index lists AFIT as established in 2018. AFIT's institutional history traces its roots to the NAF Technical and Supply School established in Kaduna in 1977; it became the Air Force Institute of Technology on 12 March 2008.

leadership.name: Air Vice Marshal Adeniran Kolade Ademuwagun
